newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - August 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - August 1.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The amount of cash available to 29 key state enterprises in Shanghai grew a year-on-year 60 percent to the end of June 1997, and warehouse stocks fell by 19.94 percent inthe same period, with the support of major banks.
- By the end of June, only 46 or 6.59 percent of China's 700 or so listed firms had issued interim results, with the August 31 deadline approaching.

- BUSINESS NEWS - The Shanghai branch of the Agricultural Bank of China plans to provide three billion yuan ($361 million) in the second half of 1997 to support the city's pillar industries and new profit-making firms.
